As a Flightline Technical Planner (d/m/w) at Airbus, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless preparation and coordination of aircraft materials and processes in the Flightline and Delivery phase. Located in Hamburg Finkenwerder, this full-time position (35h) involves a dynamic mix of technical planning, project participation, and problem-solving. Working closely with various stakeholders internally and externally, you will translate design documents into manufacturing tasks while monitoring real-time disruptions and initiating suitable measures. You will also manage material procurement, ensure adherence to technical solutions, and oversee the administrative and operational aspects of aircraft delivery to customers.

Key responsibilities include:

- Supporting aircraft operations post FOT (Fall Operation Test) at the Flightline and preparing deliveries to customers.
- Managing material procurement, delivery, and monitoring order processes.
- Recording maintenance issues and defining technical solutions.
- Identifying disruptions in real-time and coordinating corrective actions involving required departments.
- Providing technical and administrative support during the Flightline and Delivery phases.
- Planning and coordinating tasks with partners, suppliers, and external firms.
- Implementing design documents into manufacturing orders while considering technical instructions.
- Participating in projects and leading sub-projects as needed.

- Technical education or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 2 years of experience in aircraft manufacturing and 1 year in production or manufacturing engineering.
- Aerospace experience and familiarity with Flightline/Delivery operations are critical.
- Advanced knowledge of IT tools such as SAP, zamiz, Taksy/Gesy/Tesy, and Google Workspace.
- Proficiency in German and English at a negotiation level.
Benefits:

jobs.occupation: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **

Fuel your passion

- Supporting client groups through key P&C operating cycles, including salary planning, talent management, and performance management.
- Managing employee lifecycle movements such as promotions, salary adjustments, and workforce planning to ensure strong talent pipelines aligned with business needs.
- Contributing to M&A activities and related integration projects.
- Collaborating effectively with the works council on employee-related topics.
- Leading and championing P&C projects and employee engagement initiatives at the country level.
- Driving Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging initiatives and acting as an ambassador for the Baker Hughes culture.

To be successful in this role you will:

- Possess a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma/GED with relevant Human Resources experience).
- Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in German and English.
- Build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships.
- Bring ability to work independently and effectively.
- Apply strong problem-solving skills to resolve complex challenges

Applications from people with disabilities are expressly welcome. Severely disabled candidates will be given preference in the case of equal qualifications.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

- Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
- Hybrid working - working from the Celle office three days per week to foster collaboration, partnership, and connection with colleagues.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Postdoctoral Researcher CMS Experiment

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 5 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHPO009/2026 | Deadline: 24.09.2026 | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The CMS DESY group is based in Hamburg and is one of the largest groups worldwide participating in the CMS Experiment at CERN. The successful candidate will join a newly established Helmholtz Investigator Group at DESY, working within the CMS Collaboration to study how top quarks interact with the heavy bosons (W, Z, and Higgs) at the highest energies reached at the LHC. Using the full CMS dataset, the project targets these interactions in the boosted regime and interprets the measurements in the framework of Effective Field Theory, searching for subtle deviations from the Standard Model that could point to new physics. The work combines advanced jet reconstruction and identification with modern machine-learning techniques, offering the opportunity to develop expertise at the interface of experimental data analysis and cutting-edge ML methods.

About your role:

- Develop and apply advanced jet reconstruction and machine-learning techniques for the identification of boosted top quarks and heavy bosons, forming the methodological foundation shared across the group's measurements.
- Take a leading role in the unfolding of the differential cross-section measurements and in the global Effective Field Theory interpretation combining them into constraints on top-boson couplings.
- Co-supervise the group's PhD students and help shape the strategic direction of the measurement methods and analysis setup, ensuring continuity and knowledge transfer across the staggered projects.
- Contribute to CMS service and object-performance tasks.
- Represent the group within the CMS Collaboration and at international conferences, with the possibility of regular short-term research stays at CERN.

About you:

- PhD in experimental particle physics, completed or nearing completion.
- Demonstrated experience with machine-learning methods in high-energy physics, ideally applied to jet or boosted-object reconstruction and identification.
- Experience with differential cross-section measurements and unfolding techniques; familiarity with Effective Field Theory interpretations is an advantage.
- Strong scientific programming skills (e.g. Python and C++) and experience with modern ML frameworks; knowledge of the CMS software environment is beneficial.
- Ability to work both independently and within a team, to support and mentor students, and to communicate results effectively in English.
- Experience in supervising students is a bonus.
- lnterest in outreach activities is advantageous.
- Experience with global fits is a plus.
